q: He [Joe Cuba] was an icon to New York's Puerto Rican community and can be considered a pioneer of "nuyorican" (New York Puerto Rican) culture.

2009 April 3, Garth Cartwright, “Joe Cuba: Musician crowned ‘king of Latin Boogaloo’”, in Alan Rusbridger, editor, The Guardian, London: Guardian News & Media, →ISSN, →OCLC, archived from the original
